topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: Finding out that my child has the same teacher I once had, I can't help but feel a wave of memories flood back. I remember those lessons, both the challenging and the enlightening ones. It's a peculiar feeling, knowing that the person who taught me, flaws and all, is now shaping the mind of my own child. I hope I've set a better example than I did back then. There’s a part of me that worries about the mistakes I made in her class and how those might have influenced her. I’ll have to talk to my child, see how things are going, and maybe, just maybe, share a story or two about my experiences, hoping it could help smooth the path for them.
